import AssemblyExplorer from '../../../components/AssemblyExplorer.astro';

Pick a case, click through its files, and read what `bot assembly check` resolves for it on the right.

Every resolved option carries the rung it came from. A rung is one place a value can be set. `from stage` means the stage's own frontmatter set it. `from assembly` means `ASSEMBLY.md` did. `from default` means nothing in the tree did and the format's own default stands.
